# Accepted dependency advisories: the CI pip-audit gate fails on anything NOT listed here.

# diskcache: no fixed release exists. Pulled in only by dvc (dev data tooling), never imported
# at runtime by the API, worker or MCP server. Exit: upstream fix, or drop dvc.
PYSEC-2026-2447  # diskcache
#
# litellm: fixes need >=1.95 / >=1.100, above the deliberate <1.92 pin (langfuse v2 facade,
# ADR-0010). Used as a client library only, never as the LiteLLM proxy server (ADR-0008).
# Exit: migrate tracing to langfuse v3 and lift the pin. Tracked in docs/security/threat-model.md.
GHSA-g5ff-637f-6q2m  # litellm
CVE-2026-114612  # litellm
